name: Molten Glass Morph
note: Words cross-blur under an SVG alpha-threshold filter so they melt into each other like molten glass, then feSpecularLighting with a pointer-driven fePointLight puts a moving glint on the result; a registered heat number cools the glass colour and glow from 1,150°C to 24°C.

name: Inertial Caret
note: A writer revising a note, with the native caret hidden and replaced by a spring-mass bar that lags, overshoots, skews and smears along its velocity, trailed by a softer second spring; click in and it follows your own selection in a plaintext-only contenteditable.

name: Extruded Block Type
note: Each letter is 26 glyph slices stacked in preserve-3d space behind a sheen-lit face; depth is a registered <length> so pointer proximity pulls letters out and Punch slams them flat, both interpolating through linear() spring curves, while the block tilts on its own spring.

name: Particle Type Swarm
note: Up to 4,000 particles sample a word rasterised offscreen and spring to it on a DPR-aware canvas; a tap sends a radial shockwave whose distance-based delays and curl-noise drift make the next word sweep in, the pointer carves a hole that heals, and speed buckets colour fast particles in additive ember.

name: Plucked-String Type
note: Three lines of type ride SVG textPaths that behave like real strings: a drag sets the Fourier sine series of a plucked triangle, release lets nine modes ring with stiffness inharmonicity and faster-dying overtones, and sweeping across the lines strums them.
